title: Beacon Ridge Solar Share Sizing Reference Card
content:
Sizing limits and size-change terms for Community Solar Subscriptions. A subscription size is stated in kW-DC to one decimal place.

| Plan | Smallest size | Largest size for one premise | Largest share of the premise's annual usage that expected production may cover | Expected annual production used for sizing | Size change during the term | Size changes per allocation year | A size change takes effect |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Beacon Ridge Solar Share Flex | 1.0 kW | 15.0 kW | 100% | 1200 kWh per kW | Allowed | 1 | first billing cycle after the change date |
| Beacon Ridge Solar Share 1-Year | 1.0 kW | 15.0 kW | 100% | 1200 kWh per kW | Allowed | 1 | first billing cycle after the change date |
| Beacon Ridge Solar Share 5-Year | 1.0 kW | 15.0 kW | 100% | 1200 kWh per kW | Allowed | 1 | first billing cycle after the change date |
| Beacon Ridge Solar Share 10-Year | 1.0 kW | 15.0 kW | 100% | 1200 kWh per kW | Allowed | 1 | first billing cycle after the change date |
| Beacon Ridge Solar Share 20-Year | 1.0 kW | 15.0 kW | 100% | 1200 kWh per kW | Allowed | 1 | first billing cycle after the change date |
| Beacon Ridge Solar Share Income-Eligible | 1.0 kW | 15.0 kW | 100% | 1200 kWh per kW | Allowed | 1 | first billing cycle after the change date |

**Card notes**

- *Smallest and largest size:* 1.0 kW-DC is the smallest subscription size and 15.0 kW-DC the largest for one premise, on every plan.
- *Usage share:* the expected annual production of the subscription may cover at most 100 percent of the premise's annual usage.
- *Expected production:* sizing uses 1200 kWh of expected annual production per kW-DC (an integer figure).
- *Size changes:* the subscribed size may be changed during the term on every plan, at most 1 time per allocation year, effective from the first billing cycle after the change date.

**Hypothetical reading of the production figure.** A hypothetical 4.0 kW-DC subscription is expected to produce 4.0 multiplied by 1200, that is 4800 kWh a year; at the 100 percent usage share that expected production fits a premise whose annual usage is at least 4800 kWh.
